# passbolt_group (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get group matching name exactly or error
data "passbolt_group" "group_name_exact_match_example" {
  name = "exact_match_example"
}

output "group" {
  # `value` will be the group
  value = data.passbolt_group.group_name_exact_match_example
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `deleted` (Boolean)
- `group_users` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_users))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `modified` (String)
- `modified_by` (String)
- `user_count` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--group_users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_users`

Required:

- `user_id` (String) The id of the user to add.

Optional:

- `delete` (Boolean) Whether the user should be deleted from the group
- `is_admin` (Boolean) Whether to make the user admin of the group.
